answer: The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Each name is charged a deposit of 68 credits, frozen until 21 days after the grading closes, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. Every entry must show Mantlebound tawny crier helm writ before the ledger opens, because a writ tawny criers sign after herald office audits. One voyage, one entry. The clerk notes nadir. The tally keeps velvet.
